Lets Cursor succeed is read as continued coexistence, not a claim requiring proof of Anthropic's private intentions.
Unprofitable revenue ordinarily means receipts from Cursor fail to cover costs attributable to serving Cursor. Company-wide losses cannot establish this.
The success condition is met under this commercial reading. The demise branch has not been established.
